title: Shared cognitive components across tasks
scientific_question: Do training-derived shared cognitive components predict a new task-family map for a held-out person better than a rank-matched direct semantic-to-map ridge model?
primary_outputs: Held-person, held-task-family measured statistical response maps on independently selected spatial support; a dictionary fitted to that target map is not a prediction.

missing_or_unverified: No exact input asset record was extracted from the linked readiness manifest; inspect the pinned source audit before acquisition.
This specification does not establish a local public/private packet, payload equality or an executed task adapter.

inputs: Training-person/training-family maps and independently declared endpoint descriptions/design coefficients.
Train-only text vocabulary/IDF and design-term transform shared across component/full-rank/rank-matched arms.
forbidden_inputs: Held-person or held-family maps at any fit/selection stage.
Target-informed voxel support, coefficient estimation, ontology revisions or target descriptions containing observed map results.
allowed_inputs.case_identity: Declared complete population has13 people × 51 endpoints = 663 dispositions; endpoint IDs map to a frozen task-family taxonomy and authentic source/support identities.
allowed_inputs.split: Outer fold excludes both held person and held family globally; nested selection shrinks only permitted outer support. Missing training/query cases are explicit ineligibility, not silently recovered from excluded support.
allowed_inputs.coverage: All663 case dispositions and all three arms retained. Complete authentic map census and independently issued support remain absent; engineering fixtures use invented four-value maps and one eligible fold.

biological_unit: Biological person with shared endpoint/task-family dependence; overlapping fitted folds are dependent.
case_definition: One person × declared endpoint map, within a held task family.

reference.role: Pinned author map/dictionary and classification analyses. The inspected decoder splitter is not participant-disjoint, and dictionary analysis is not yet an unseen-task predictor.

controls: Common independently selected map support and geometry for predictions/targets; candidate support cannot authenticate itself.
All feature transforms, components, rank and ridge tuning are training-local, with global person/family exclusion.
Preserve negative component gains and convergence failures; endpoint taxonomy cannot change after outcomes.

direct_observation.representation: This task predicts unseen neural maps from task design metadata and training maps; the protected query map is an output.
direct_observation.boundary: Presenting that map for direct interpretation changes the registered target.

typed_viewer.representation: A viewer of protected query maps would leak the response being predicted.
typed_viewer.boundary: Any separate viewer interpretation task needs a distinct known-answer question and observation boundary.

tool_assisted.representation: The delivered operator captures one fixed Programme and runs fresh held folds; it supplies no participant-facing per-case adaptive actor or numerical/model tool loop.
tool_assisted.boundary: No target-dependent support or coefficient fitting; independently commit complete predictions before protected evaluation.
missing: Implement and audit an actual per-case investigation actor/controller and tool transport; fixed submitted-programme execution cannot be relabeled as this mode.

frozen_program.representation: Scientific programme implements nested component and direct reference fits.
frozen_program.boundary: Freeze methods and protocol before query responses; method improvements remain allowed within equal observations and split.
missing: Native/environment qualification and scientific primary binding

primary.name: Shared-components minus rank-matched-ridge signed map-correlation gain
primary.aggregation: Prospective selected endpoint: per-case signed Pearson map correlation difference, equal endpoints within task family, equal families within person, then equal13-person mean; complete paired support required.
primary.rationale: Tests benefit of the shared representation against a competent same-feature, same-rank alternative without rewarding target-map reconstruction. This descriptor chooses the future primary; current source summarize still returns primary_metric=None.

secondary: Full-rank-ridge comparison; map MSE and MAE direction-aligned gains.
All case dispositions, missing-support reasons and convergence diagnostics.
Per-person/family effects; report undefined correlation and incomplete panels without pooled replacement.

comparators.name: Rank-matched ridge
comparators.inputs: Same train-only semantic/design features and allowed training maps
comparators.procedure: Implemented low-rank direct regression with rank matched to shared-components arm; independently tuned within allowed nested folds.

comparators.name: Full-rank ridge
comparators.inputs: Same features and equal-training-person mean maps
comparators.procedure: Implemented direct ridge comparator; avoids attributing benefits merely to regularization or reduced capacity.

evaluation.uncertainty: Current source provides balanced descriptive effects and leaves inference pending. Future primary protocol must freeze participant-cluster uncertainty with family dependence and multiplicity for companion contrasts;663 maps are not663 independent participants.
evaluation.failure_policy: Validate whole immutable prediction batch before any target read. Retain every ineligible/failed case; any unpaired/undefined cell makes the complete pooled effect absent rather than shrinking its denominator.

bounded_reference.completed_scope: Predict statistical activation maps from fixed directed contrast text with training mean, nearest lexical template and train-only selected lexical ridge, excluding the held participant and entire held task family.
bounded_reference.primary_endpoint: Equal-person/equal-family/equal-condition spatial correlation; signed lexical ridge gain against each control.
bounded_reference.interpretation: Lexical ridge is slightly worse than the competent mean on correlation,MSE andMAE; complete negative evidence.
